# Owned interface seed and fixed varargs array

A public static CharSequence-bounded seed/result retains an independent String,
an original Object[] varargs array and IllegalArgumentException declaration.
Source and SDK-provider profiles compile all output and preserve metadata and
Exceptions. Four immutable routes run 96 fresh JVM cases twice with opaque
CharSequences, nulls, covariant/empty/cyclic arrays, aliases, callback writes,
opaque results and exact late failures. Six wrong programs and six
Code-preserving controls guard scope, fixed array invocation and erasure.
Only owned fixture and standard SDK code executes. Use JDK 25; originals use
release 8 and recovery uses its reported Java release.
